operationalFollowUp.reason: Requires commit, push, PR, and final deploy from the committed tree.

Cloudflare lists PUBLIC_WEB3FORMS_KEY and TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY, but encrypted secret values cannot be read back or renamed automatically. WEB3FORMS_ACCESS_KEY should be added with the same value, then the legacy fallback can be removed.

Automated tests cover server success with mocked upstreams and client success with a mocked same-origin response. A true live positive send requires a real Turnstile solve and will send a real Web3Forms message.
